title: Live Streams
subtitle: Move from a running-state overview into a per-stream workspace for inputs, outputs, distribution and controls

info.testModeNote: Test mode: no CDN domain configured, pull URLs point directly at SRS (testing only); loopback hosts in the push URL are replaced with this panel's host.

transcode.label: Transcode Template
transcode.note: When bound, the stream is transcoded with the template's parameters. Templates are managed on the Transcode Templates page.

external.title: Unregistered live inputs detected
external.hint: These publishers have reached SRS but their stream names are not registered in the console. Register them before managing them in a workspace.

workspace.subtitle: Inspect the real input, configured outputs, access endpoints and distribution relationships in one stream context

signal.title: Signal Path
signal.subtitle: Green is reserved for state actually observed from the runtime; configured resources are not automatically treated as healthy.

input.idleHint: SRS currently reports no publishing connection for this stream. This may simply mean the stream has not started yet.
input.srsUnavailable: SRS runtime state is currently unavailable, so input status cannot be determined.
input.inPullUnavailable: The IN-PULL Worker is currently unavailable, so managed pull runtime cannot be verified.

managedPull.title: Managed Pull · IN-PULL
managedPull.subtitle: An independent Pull Worker uses FFmpeg to fetch a registered third-party source and publish it back into the current SRS stream. Desired State and Runtime State remain separate.
managedPull.workerUnavailableHint: The task still desires RUNNING, but the Pull Worker heartbeat is unavailable. The desired state is preserved and will reconcile when the Worker returns; the console will not pretend the task is currently running.
managedPull.noSources: No active external source is available.
managedPull.failoverHint: Automatic failover moves from the preferred source toward fallbacks by priority. Once a fallback takes over, the system does not automatically fail back to the primary source.
managedPull.unknownSwitchError: The source switch failed without additional error details
managedPull.manualSwitchHint: Uses break-before-make: stop the current Managed Pull, verify the old publisher is gone, then start the target source. A short interruption may occur.
managedPull.switchConfirmDescription: Switch from {{from}} to {{to}}. The system will stop the current pull and verify the old publisher is gone before starting the target source. A short interruption may occur.

operationState.QUEUED: Queued and waiting for the Worker
operationState.STOPPING: Stopping the current pull and waiting for the old publisher to disappear
operationState.STARTING: The old input is released; preparing the target source
operationState.VERIFYING: The target pull has started; waiting for SRS publisher evidence

managedPull.sourceCreateHint: The new source is selected after saving but pull does not start automatically.
managedPull.noSourcesInline: No active external source is available. Register one directly in this workspace.

outputs.forwardHint: OUT-PUSH managed by the Push Worker; runtime state does not prove remote playback health
outputs.cdnHint: CDN channels bound to this stream; failed remote state queries are shown as unknown
outputs.pullHint: Playback connections currently initiated by third parties

endpoints.title: Access Endpoints
endpoints.subtitle: Addresses are derived from the current stream configuration; copying an address does not change runtime state.

activity.title: Recent Observed Events
activity.note: hook_events currently retains only the latest occurrence of each event type. This is an observation summary, not a complete audit trail.

confirm.publisherDescription: This actively disconnects only publishing sessions for this stream. The console will not enumerate and kick playback sessions. SRS may naturally end playback when the source disappears, and the publisher may reconnect on its own.
confirm.viewersDescription: This actively disconnects {{count}} playback session(s), but leaves the publisher connected and does not prevent clients from pulling the stream again.

danger.title: Connection Controls
danger.description: These actions control current SRS sessions only. Use Third-party Pull Access for new-session admission and grants; disconnecting current sessions, pausing new sessions, and revoking grants remain separate operations.
danger.managedPullDescription: This input is driven by Managed Pull Desired State. To actually stop the input, use Stop in Managed Pull. Kicking the current publisher would only cause the Worker to reconcile it back, so that misleading action is hidden here.

managedPush.title: Managed Outbound Push · OUT-PUSH
managedPush.subtitle: A dedicated Push Worker reads the current SRS stream and actively pushes it to third-party targets with FFmpeg. Stop terminates the local outbound process.
managedPush.workerUnavailableHint: At least one push expects RUNNING, but the Push Worker heartbeat is unavailable. Desired state is preserved without reporting false success.
managedPush.empty: No managed outbound targets are configured for this stream.
managedPush.evidenceHint: RUNNING proves only that the managed FFmpeg process is alive while local input is online. Remote playback health still requires independent platform/CDN evidence.
managedPush.legacyHint: This legacy task remains on SRS Dynamic Forward to avoid double-pushing during upgrades. See Sources & Outbound Push for its compatibility control semantics.
managedPush.createHint: New targets remain STOPPED until explicitly started to prevent accidental distribution.
managedPush.invalidUrl: Enter a valid RTMP / RTMPS / SRT URL.

outPull.title: Third-party Pull · OUT-PULL
outPull.subtitle: Control SRS Origin endpoint availability, new-session admission, access grants, and current sessions independently.
outPull.sessionControlHint: Pausing new sessions or revoking grants does not disconnect established playback sessions. Disconnecting current sessions is a separate action.
outPull.tokenOnce: The access token is shown only once. Copy and store it now.
outPull.originOnlyHint: This policy controls direct SRS Origin playback only. Third-party CDN domains still require separate provider-side authentication and verification.

console.title: On-Air Console
console.subtitle: Keep video, acquisition, bitrate, audience and media format in one operating context.

path.title: Business Signal Path
path.subtitle: Read the stream in operating order: acquisition → SRS source → processing/transcode → distribution.
path.evidenceNote: Green is reserved for runtime evidence
path.srsCoreHint: Media actually observed on this node
path.legacyTranscodeNote: This is a legacy single-profile configuration record, not evidence that transcoding is running.
path.processingPending: Multi-rendition runtime will be attached through a real Worker in the next phase.
path.distributionHint: Managed push, CDN and third-party pull
path.guardsAttached: Authentication, hotlink protection and session controls attach to outputs

processing.title: Processing & Transcode
processing.subtitle: Only real runtime state is shown; the legacy single-profile field is no longer presented as active transcoding.
processing.passthroughHint: Without re-encoding the system cannot change GOP/keyint, resolution or codec parameters.
processing.legacyHint: This record will migrate to an observable binding when the multi-transcode runtime lands.
processing.next: Multi-transcode Worker next: 1080P, 720P, audio-only and GOP/keyint control.
processing.runtimeSubtitle: One Transcode Pipeline produces all renditions for this source. A rendition is healthy only when SRS actually observes its derived stream.
processing.empty: No derived transcodes are mounted. Source passthrough remains available.
processing.pipelineHint: All renditions of one source are produced by a single FFmpeg pipeline and share one timeline. Mount/start/stop/template changes rebuild that pipeline, so sibling renditions may restart briefly.

empty.title: No Live Streams
empty.description: No live streams have been registered yet.

preview.error: Playback failed: make sure the stream is publishing and the pull URL is reachable.
preview.notSupported: This browser does not support HLS playback.
